technology_name: A Novel Method of Storing and Delivering PGPR Microbes Through Biocapsule
problem_solved: Inefficient storage and delivery of beneficial PGPR microorganisms
description: This technology provides a method for storing and delivering Plant Growth Promoting Rhizobacteria (PGPR) using a biocapsule system. The approach is intended to improve handling and application of beneficial microbes in agricultural systems while supporting plant growth promotion activities.
applications:
Agricultural bio-input and microbial inoculant manufacturers
Organic farming and sustainable agriculture enterprises
Seed treatment and crop nutrition companies
Farmer producer organizations (FPOs) and agricultural cooperatives
Government agriculture departments and soil health management programs
secondary_sector: Biotechnology & Life Sciences, Agribusiness & Rural Economy
